# GLAD Studio

> Full-service software studio specializing in AI-powered web applications, mobile app development, data engineering, and business automation.

## Core Capabilities
- **MVP Development**: High-velocity v1 creation for startups (4–8 week delivery timeline).
- **Web Application Development**: Scalable SaaS platforms, custom dashboards, and web portals using React, TypeScript, and TanStack.
- **Mobile Development**: Cross-platform Android & iOS applications using Flutter and React Native.
- **AI & Automation**: Custom LLM integrations, conversational AI, automated lead enrichment, and workflow orchestration.

## AI Engineering Insights
- **AI Development Cost in India (2026)**: A realistic engineering breakdown of AI software development costs in India—covering RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, vector databases, model token usage, and operational maintenance (https://gladstudio.net/insights/ai-development-cost-india)
- **AI Agent vs Chatbot**: Technical comparison between conversational interfaces and autonomous goal-driven agents capable of executing multi-step business actions via tool calling and API connectors (https://gladstudio.net/insights/ai-agent-vs-chatbot)
- **What Is AI Agent Development?**: In-depth engineering blueprint detailing how AI agents plan tasks, invoke APIs, query vector stores, manage state, and adhere to deterministic safety guardrails (https://gladstudio.net/insights/what-is-ai-agent-development)
- **RAG vs Fine-Tuning**: Architectural decision guide comparing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (pgvector) against model parameter fine-tuning for factual accuracy, data freshness, privacy, and hybrid systems (https://gladstudio.net/insights/rag-vs-fine-tuning)
- **How to Build an AI Agent for Business**: A 9-step implementation roadmap for designing, evaluating, and deploying production-ready AI agents with real-world tool integrations and human checkpoints (https://gladstudio.net/insights/how-to-build-ai-agent-for-business)

## Services
- **MVP Development**: Custom MVP engineering for startups and businesses. GLAD Studio designs and builds scalable web, mobile, and SaaS MVPs with production-ready architecture, type safety, and 100% IP ownership (https://gladstudio.net/services/mvp-development)
- **Web Application Development**: Full-stack custom web applications and multi-tenant SaaS platforms engineered with React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Node.js, and PostgreSQL (https://gladstudio.net/services/web-application-development)
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications built using Flutter and React Native with offline-first local SQLite sync and biometric security (https://gladstudio.net/services/mobile-app-development)
- **AI Solutions**: Production-grade AI systems including custom LLM applications, autonomous AI agents with LangGraph/CrewAI, RAG retrieval pipelines with pgvector, and computer vision models (https://gladstudio.net/services/ai-solutions)
- **Business Automation**: Custom workflow automation, API integrations, lead enrichment pipelines, and self-hosted n8n instances to eliminate manual data entry and streamline operations (https://gladstudio.net/services/business-automation)

## Proprietary Software Products
- **GLAD HMS**: Modular, multi-tenant Hotel Management System (HMS) for room reservations, front desk operations, housekeeping task boards, stay folios, and USALI revenue analytics (https://gladstudio.net/products/glad-hms)
- **SettleDesk**: Real estate brokerage operating system unifying property catalogs, agent workflows, deal approvals, and commission split payouts (https://gladstudio.net/products/settledesk)
